# Optional model-plugin dependencies, layered on the existing CUDA13 runtime.
# This file does not replace the shared Bazel requirements locks. Environments
# enabling the SM10x BF16 V4.1 vision FFN must provision this plugin explicitly,
# like the model's FA4 plugin; runtime code never installs packages or changes
# sys.path. No broad dependency-lock update is part of this source-only change.
#
# Official source used in the FFN operator screen (Quack version 0.6.5).
# Pin the commit/archive, not a potentially different release with that version.
